title: Removal of the Fwd Cargo Compartment Lining Panels

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the ceiling and upper sidewall lining panels of the forward cargo compartment, in the sequence that keeps the smoke detection air path intact until the last panel is out.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the ceiling and upper sidewall lining panels of the forward cargo compartment for access to the structure, the wiring and the attenuation blankets behind them.
sections.job_setup_note: The compartment must be empty and the cargo nets removed. The smoke detection system must be inhibited at the maintenance panel before the first ceiling panel is removed, because the air path changes as soon as the ceiling is open and the system will otherwise give a spurious indication. Work from the aft end of the compartment forward, so that each panel is supported by the one behind it until it is released.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the compartment is empty and that the cargo nets are removed. 2. Inhibit the smoke detection system at the maintenance panel and install the warning notice. WARNING: DO NOT LEAVE THE SMOKE DETECTION SYSTEM INHIBITED WHEN THE AIRCRAFT IS RELEASED TO SERVICE. 3. Remove the cargo compartment light lenses. 4. Release the quick-release fasteners of the aftmost ceiling panel and support it. 5. Disconnect the light assembly D2550118482429 from the panel and put a protective cap on the connector. 6. Lower the panel clear and put it on the padded trestle. CAUTION: DO NOT PUT A LINING PANEL FACE DOWN ON THE COMPARTMENT FLOOR. THE DECORATIVE FACE IS EASILY SCORED AND THE PANEL IS NOT REPAIRABLE. 7. Do steps 4 to 6 again for each ceiling panel, working forward. 8. Remove the upper sidewall panels D2550113609050 in the same order. 9. Remove the upper trim strip 9911DL and keep the fasteners. 10. Do a general visual inspection of the exposed structure and of the drain path in zones 111, 113 and 116.
sections.close_out: Identify each panel by position before it leaves the compartment. Cover the exposed harness connectors. Confirm that the smoke detection inhibit is recorded in the aircraft technical log and that the warning notice stays in position until the panels are back in. Report any blocked drain path found during step 10.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-161204 aircraft carry attenuation blankets behind the panels; the blanket edge is trapped by the panel return and comes away with the panel.

safety_precautions: Inhibit the smoke detection system and put the warning notice in position.
Make sure that the cargo loading system is de-energised.
Use a padded trestle for every removed panel.
